title: fix: Layout cleanup - login page bare, homepage with SiteLayout
body:
## Summary

Clean up routing layout after the premium light-theme refactor. This PR addresses:

1. **Login page (`/login`)**: Now completely bare — no navbar, no footer, no layout chrome
2. **Home page (`/`)**: Uses `SiteLayout` with header + sidebar navigation
3. **Protected routes** (`/dashboard`, `/routes`, `/companion`, `/caregiver`): Continue using `SiteLayout` under `ProtectedRoute`

## Changes

- `src/app/router.tsx`: Simplified router structure
  - Home page wrapped in `SiteLayout` (header + 232px sidebar)
  - Login page is a bare route (full-screen auth form)
  - Protected routes wrapped in `ProtectedRoute` > `SiteLayout`
- Deleted `src/components/PublicLayout.tsx` (was adding unwanted footer/navbar to auth pages)

## Why

After the premium theme refactor (PR #4) and route planner (PR #5), the layout hierarchy got confused:
- `PublicLayout` added a marketing footer to login page ?
- Home page lost its sidebar navigation ?

This PR restores the intended architecture:

| Route | Layout | Purpose |
|-------|--------|---------|
| `/` | `SiteLayout` | Map-centric home with sidebar nav |
| `/login` | *none* | Clean auth form, no distractions |
| `/dashboard` | `ProtectedRoute` > `SiteLayout` | Auth + nav |
| `/routes` | `ProtectedRoute` > `SiteLayout` | Auth + nav |
| `/companion` | `ProtectedRoute` > `SiteLayout` | Auth + nav |
| `/caregiver` | `ProtectedRoute` > `SiteLayout` | Auth + nav |

## Testing

```bash
npm run build   # ? passes (469 kB JS, 48 kB CSS gzipped)
npm run lint    # ? zero errors
```

## Related
- PR #4: Premium light-theme refactor (merged)
- PR #5: Route planner with green corridor AQI scoring (open)
